playground_intro: Build a mandate by clicking, then test what an agent may do. Everything runs in your browser – nothing is sent anywhere.
playground_intro_short: Build a mandate by tapping and test it. Everything stays in your browser.
playground_engine: Decisions come from spec-ts, an independent TypeScript implementation that passes the conformance cases of specification {version}.
playground_ex_voice_body: Lights and heating yes, doors only with a question, cameras never.
playground_ex_energy_body: Heating, the wallbox from 6 to 22 and the pool pump. Reads sensors.
playground_ex_shopping_body: Only reads: pantry sensors and the fridge contents, not on Sundays.
playground_ex_build_body: Start empty. Everything is denied until you allow it.
playground_field_approvers_hint: Who confirms; empty: as in the mandate ({approvers})
playground_by_id: a device by ID or area
playground_empty_body: Everything is denied. Add a rule or pick an example.
playground_strict_note: Order doesn’t matter – the strictest matching rule wins:
playground_warn_star: “Do anything” includes critical actions such as unlocking. This rule cannot allow them without a question: allow_critical needs the actions listed.
playground_warn_demoted: This rule allows a critical action. Without allow_critical a person must still confirm it.
playground_warn_critical: Critical actions under this rule run without anyone confirming them.
playground_req_critical: The household marks this device as critical
playground_req_value_decimals: Enter a number with at most {places} decimal places.
playground_critical_body: It only runs without a question if every matching allow rule carries allow_critical. Otherwise a person must confirm it.
playground_reason_no_mandate: There is no mandate for this agent, so everything is denied.
playground_reason_ambiguous_mandate: Several mandates apply at the same time. None of them wins, so everything is denied.
playground_reason_invalid_mandate: The mandate is not valid, so everything is denied. Step 6 shows what is wrong.
playground_reason_invalid_request: The request is not valid (for example a device ID with spaces, or a value that is not a whole number in the unit), so it is denied.
playground_reason_unknown_resource: The device is not in the household’s directory, so it is denied.
playground_reason_unknown_category: The device category is not in the vocabulary, so it is denied.
playground_reason_unknown_action: This device category has no such action, so it is denied.
playground_reason_revoked: The mandate has been revoked, so everything is denied.
playground_reason_not_yet_valid: The mandate is only valid from {from}, so everything is denied.
playground_reason_expired: The mandate expired on {until}, so everything is denied.
playground_reason_no_match: No rule matches. Anything not explicitly allowed is denied.
playground_reason_critical_demotion: Rule “{id}” would allow “{action}” for {device}, but the action is critical and the rule does not carry allow_critical. A person must confirm.
playground_reason_rule_deny: Rule “{id}” applies: “{action}” for {device} is not allowed.
playground_matrix_hint: Click a cell to test it. Hover or focus shows the deciding rule. Arrow keys move between cells.
playground_matrix_hint_mobile: Swipe sideways for all actions. Tap a cell to open it in “Test”.
playground_matrix_caption: Decision per device category and action
playground_edit_hint: You can edit the JSON directly. Valid changes appear in the rules above.
playground_err_syntax: The JSON can’t be read. Check commas, quotes and brackets.
playground_err_duplicate_key: The field “{key}” appears twice in the same object.
playground_err_too_large: A mandate may be at most 256 KiB.
playground_err_not_text: The text contains characters that are not valid UTF-8.
playground_err_unknown_field: The field “{field}” is not part of a mandate.
playground_err_wrong_value: “{field}” has a value that is not allowed here.
playground_err_wrong_format: “{field}” is not written in the required form.
playground_err_wrong_size: “{field}” has too few or too many entries or characters.
playground_err_wrong_time: “{field}” is not a valid point in time.
playground_err_action_unknown: The action “{action}” does not belong to the vocabulary of this device category.
playground_err_window_equal: The time window starts and ends at the same time.
playground_err_min_max: The limit for “{param}” has a minimum greater than its maximum.
playground_err_no_parameter: The action “{action}” has no value “{param}” that could be limited.
playground_err_timeout: The wait for a confirmation must be between 10 seconds and 1 hour.
playground_err_not_displayable: A name contains characters that must not be shown to people (such as invisible or control characters).
playground_err_duplicate_rule: Two rules have the same id.
playground_nojs_body: Everything else on this site works without it. You can still read the example mandate below, or [read the specification](/spec/v0/).
playground_desc_ask_all: {resource}: {agent} may do anything{when}, but only after confirmation{who}.
playground_desc_unknown: {resource}: this rule has no valid decision.
